_style: Cinematic 35mm film still, 16:9 widescreen, documentary reenactment, moody natural light, warm tungsten highlights and teal shadows, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain. No text, no logos, no brand marks. Any person is seen from behind, in silhouette or out of focus: no recognizable face.
ia_chambre: Night, a modest bedroom in a small working-class house in Rosario, Argentina, late 1990s. A small 11-year-old boy seen from behind sits on the edge of his bed in pyjamas, head lowered, a single bedside lamp, a worn football on the floor.
ia_seringue: Extreme close-up at night on a bedside table: a growth hormone injection pen and a small vial next to a scuffed children's football, warm lamp light, dark background, late 1990s.
ia_toise: A height chart drawn in pencil on a peeling painted wall of a 1990s Argentine home, small pencil marks with dates barely rising, a child's hand from out of frame touching the top mark, soft window light.
ia_terrain_terre: Golden hour on a dusty neighbourhood football pitch in Argentina, 1990s: a very small boy in silhouette dribbles a ball past much taller kids, long shadows, dust in the backlight.
ia_acierie: Interior of a 1980s steel mill in Argentina, glowing molten metal and sparks, a worker in silhouette with a helmet seen from behind, dramatic orange light and haze.
ia_rue: A quiet working-class street in Rosario, Argentina at dusk, 1990s: low brick houses, a lone street lamp, kids in silhouette kicking a ball far down the street, warm sky.
ia_grandmere: Seen from behind: an elderly woman in a cardigan holds the hand of a very small boy carrying a football, walking towards a small fenced neighbourhood football pitch at sunset, 1990s Argentina.
ia_ciel: Silhouette of a young footballer seen from behind on an empty pitch at sunset, both index fingers raised to a vast golden sky, stadium lights in the distance.
ia_avion: View through an airplane window at dawn over the Atlantic ocean, wing visible, clouds lit pink and gold, a small child's hand resting on the window frame, year 2000.
ia_serviette: A crumpled white paper napkin on a café table on the terrace of a tennis club in Barcelona, year 2000, with a blurry handwritten agreement and a signature (illegible), a ballpoint pen, an espresso cup, soft afternoon light.
ia_terrain_masia: Early morning at a youth football academy training pitch near Barcelona, early 2000s: a very small boy seen from behind with a ball at his feet, taller teenagers blurred in the background, mist and soft light.
ia_dortoir: Night in a simple academy dormitory room in Barcelona, early 2000s: a small boy seen from behind sits at the window looking at the city lights, a suitcase under the bed, homesick mood.
ia_journaux: A pile of Argentine sports newspapers on a café counter in Buenos Aires, blurred headline layouts with no readable text, morning light, cup of coffee, documentary mood.
ia_vestiaire: An empty football locker room at night after a lost final, a single light-blue and white striped shirt with the number 10 hanging on a hook, towels on the floor, cold fluorescent light, melancholic.
ia_genoux: Night in a huge stadium, a footballer in a light-blue and white striped shirt seen from far behind, kneeling alone in the centre of the pitch, teammates running towards him blurred, confetti in the air.
ia_conference: An empty press conference table in Barcelona with many microphones, a box of tissues and a glass of water, camera flashes in the blurred foreground, emotional atmosphere.
ia_penalty: Low angle on a penalty spot in a giant night stadium, a football placed on the spot, a goalkeeper out of focus in the background, thousands of blurry phone lights in the stands, extreme tension.
ia_trophee: A golden football trophy (generic shape, not a real trophy) held up into the night sky by hands seen from behind, gold confetti falling, stadium lights flaring.
